{{Top}}
{{Quote|I am but a mirror whose only purpose is to show you what your own eyes cannot see.|Kreia, the teacher of Meetra Surik|audio=KreiaMirror.flac|<ref name="kotor2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
}}
A '''teacher''' was an individual who taught other beings. They were employed by educational organizations such as [[school]]s and [[University/Legends|universities]].

The [[Koth Melan's father|father]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Koth Melan]] was a teacher, who attempted to teach his students about the true nature of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was arrested on false charges of [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] and [[Death/Legends|executed]].<ref name="soten">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
